purpose: Input manifest of the core attack / damage / range residual convergence. Audit evidence only: no runtime module reads it; each row names the structured source field, the consumer and the policy.

rows.reason: Sith sword: a swift-action Force Point empowerment (+1 Dark Side Score) for the next attack. A resource-cost activation with no owning subsystem; not attack legality.
Sith sword counts as a lightsaber for Block / Deflect / Redirect Shot: the reaction roll reads it (defense-and-reaction-interactions).
Xerrol Nightstinger: a prose mention ("remains a separate equipment record on p.67"); no structured compatibility to execute.
Darter: surveillance-tagger compatibility belongs to the equipment authority (p.67); not attack resolution.
Duplicate boolean of the above equipment compatibility.
Sniper blaster rifle: the Rapid Recycler upgrade is excluded -- customization workbench rule (UpgradeSlotEngine), not attack resolution.
Adhesive grenade: targets in the blast make a grapple check or cannot move for 3 rounds (grab/grapple state + persistent duration).
Rotary blaster cannon: braced Autofire covers the published 2x4 area instead of the generic 2x2 (resolveAutofireArea; the braced state of the Autofire attack selects it).
R-9 flash canister: detonates on contact (separate from the 3-square burst geometry); a chosen timer is ignored.

Ripper: when damage exceeds the damage threshold and moves the target at least one step down the condition track, embedded shrapnel deals an extra 1d4 immediately. An Apply Damage condition-track follow-up (persistent-effects / threshold path).

Remote grenade: the published rule ("cannot be remotely detonated within 100 meters of the transmitter") is prose only; the numeric distance is not structured and no remote-detonation workflow exists. A source-certified structured field is needed before anything can execute it.
Thermal detonator: the thrower's timer choice (1-3 rounds) is validated against the published range and carried in the workflow's area shape; the choice itself stays the player's.

The +2 is an ALLY's attack bonus against a target the wielder designated; it needs cross-actor designation state (who designated whom, repeated each round), not a modifier on this attack. No owning subsystem exists.
Eligible-weapon scope of the ally bonus above (missile launcher / grenade launcher / vehicle weapon); same cross-actor designation state.

Which attack the wielder may use for an attack of opportunity (ranged shot / affixed bayonet). AoO eligibility is adjudicated manually today (combat-actions-mapper: "GM/player confirms the selected weapon is AoO-eligible") and the base SWSE rule for ranged-weapon AoOs is not automated here. Owner: reach-and-threat.
Garrote: an attack with it is TREATED AS a grab attack (feat/talent grab bonuses apply). Needs the grab/grapple state machine (grab-grapple-restrain).

Weapon-level attack modifier under the structural fire-state condition {fireMode: autofire}; evaluated by resolveAttackStageModifiers and fed through the existing typed situational-contribution pipeline (rollAttack and Autofire).
Weapon-declared AoO capability exception tied to the stock state; no AoO eligibility enforcer exists (manual adjudication) and the stock-state model is I-B.
Weapon-declared AoO capability. No AoO eligibility enforcer exists to apply it to (manual adjudication). Owner: reach-and-threat.
Weapon-declared AoO capability tied to the folded-stock configuration state; no AoO eligibility enforcer exists and the stock/configuration model is I-B.

rows.structuredSourceField: attackProfiles[] (the weapon publishes no thrown profile)
rows.reason: The Vibrolance publishes no thrown attack profile, so selecting a thrown form fails closed (profile not found): the same fact as the operation key.
Brace legality: a mount-only brace is refused only when the weapon is KNOWN not to be mounted; an unobserved mount state is asked once (never a blanket prohibition).

rows.structuredSourceField: attackProfiles[].conditionalModifiers (attack of opportunity while wielded one-handed, +1)
rows.reason: The profile conditional modifier carries the same +1; it is now evaluated through condition-policy (AUTO when the attack declares an attack of opportunity and its wielding, otherwise the stored prompt).
A detached bayonet is treated as a Knife / Vibrodagger: configuration-and-wielding (host/attachment state).

Entrenching Tool: its published -2 (operation.attackPenalty) REPLACES the -5 improvised-weapon penalty. This runtime applies no improvised penalty, so the -2 is the weapon's inherent attack modifier. CONSUMER_DEFECT fixed: the 5D-H census counted operation.attackPenalty "consumed" only because the identifier exists elsewhere (actor.system.attackPenalty) -- the weapon's -2 was never applied.
Mortar line-of-sight origin height (20 squares) needs a line-of-sight / sensing model (concealment-stealth-sensing); no LOS engine exists.

The Darter's "maximum range Short" is published as range.hardMaxSquares (40). CONSUMER_DEFECT fixed: hardMaxSquares was carried but never limited the allowed bands; canonical-range now drops every band that begins beyond it.
The Stun Pistol's 20-square maximum is range.hardMaxSquares; only the bands that begin within 20 squares remain legal (same consumer fix as above).
The SG-4 prose rule is carried structurally by the profiles' conditionalRangeRules; resolveRangeEnvironment evaluates them through condition-policy.
The profile conditional modifier is evaluated through condition-policy against the attack's observed aim state (AUTO when the attack states aim, otherwise a stored prompt).
The riot gun "favors autofire": a UI default-selection hint with no legality or arithmetic effect (single and autofire are both legal and priced by singleShotAttackPenalty / autofireEquipmentBonus).
The Energy Lance's plasma-bolt profile already uses the rifle range family and has no stun setting ("functions as a blaster carbine without stun").

CR-1 blast cannon: the band penalty applies to the DAMAGE roll, not the attack roll. CONSUMER_DEFECT fixed: range.penaltyApplication was carried but never consumed (the attack roll took the penalty and damage took none).

E-Web missile launcher: a per-attack "Range Preparation" option (one band closer; stacks with Far Shot) whose structured two-swift-action cost is paid through the existing action economy. DATA_COMPLETENESS amendment: the cost was prose only; a structured requiredActions copy is added through the controlled amendment path.
Designation must be maintained by repeating the attack each round: cross-round, cross-actor designation state (see allyAttackBonus). No owning subsystem exists.
Weapon-level attack modifier under the structural fire-state condition {fireMode: single}.
The profile conditional modifier is evaluated through condition-policy against the observed range band (AUTO).
Sonic stunner: "deaf targets can still be harmed". The runtime models no deafness immunity, so there is nothing to override; informational only.
Battering ram: the prose rule is carried structurally as a target-rule requirement; resolveTargetRequirements evaluates it (a definite "no" refuses the attack before any cost).

EMP grenade: hit/miss damage fractions depend on whether the target is a droid / vehicle / electronic / cybernetic (target-type-dependent half-damage resolution). It shares the Evasion / half-damage-on-miss path owned by defense-and-reaction-interactions.
Sniper blaster rifle: the profile conditional modifier carries the -5 and is evaluated against the attack's observed aim state.

Rotary blaster cannon: the additional -5 applies to autofire that is not braced (structural condition {fireMode: autofire, braced: false}); the braced state of the Autofire attack is observed, otherwise asked once.
Energy Lance: when the attack is explicitly underwater only the listed profiles are legal; an unknown environment never restricts anything.
E-Web repeating blaster: -2 unless a second crewman regulated the generator since the same initiative count last round. Needs the crew-and-emplacement model.
CR-1 blast cannon: +1d8 damage against an adjacent target. The adjacency of the target is asked once at the attack and stored; the damage composition adds the die after the weapon multiplier.

Disruptors treat every target's damage threshold as 5 lower: a TARGET_THRESHOLD-stage fact applied at Apply Damage (existing pattern: options.thresholdMeasuredDamage as in grapple-feat-actions). Owner: defense-and-reaction-interactions.
Tactical tractor beam: falling-object damage by object size for a hurled object. Needs the utility-and-movement (grabbed object) model.

rows.structuredSourceField: damageReductionInteraction (mode conditional, "target is an unattended object")
rows.reason: Fire Blade: the conditional DR exception is the structured damageReductionInteraction; the 5D-E dr-conditional PROMPT (asked once, stored) executes it.
Pulse-wave pistol/rifle: +4/+5 equipment bonus to damage at point-blank range, composed once in the existing damage composition from the observed range band.

Power Hammer: Power Attack extra damage may be added against objects and vehicles. The composition adds Power Attack damage to every target type (no object/vehicle exclusion exists to lift); regression-tested.

rows.structuredSourceField: damage mitigation stage order (Shield Rating is stage 1; bypass-dr only touches stage 2)
rows.reason: Lightsaber chassis: SR still applies because the DR-ignore flag only affects the Damage Reduction stage; structural regression test on the stage order.

Bow and sling: the Strength modifier applies to damage once. CONSUMER_DEFECT fixed: getDamageAbilityContribution returned 0 for every non-thrown ranged weapon, so the published Strength damage was silently lost; the canonical operation flag now adds it exactly once (never doubled).
Long-handle lightsaber: wielded two-handed the wielder may forgo doubling the Strength bonus for a 2d10 base. Needs the wielding model (hands state) that I-B owns.
Electrostaff DR 20 is the weapon's own damage reduction AS AN OBJECT (when struck); durability / object statistics.
The weapon-object DR above is not ignored by lightsabers; durability / object statistics.
Shockstaff: the published value is "not_stated_in_KOTOR_entry" -- the source is silent; recorded, never invented.

Retrosaber: the burnout dice are the burnout profile's damage. The overcharge -> burnout DURATION sequencing (until end of next turn; cannot dial up for a round) is persisted activation state: I-B (configuration / activation state).
Stunning gauntlet: native-stun capability (5D-E) makes the stun damage mode effective.
Grenade launcher: damage, damage type and burst come from the LOADED grenade (ammo payload delegation). Needs the ammunition/payload loading model (ammo-resource-reload).
Targeting laser: the attack roll resolves and the damage roll is refused (resolveCanonicalDamage status no-damage).
Electronet: a trapped target takes stun damage again at the start of the attacker's turn (persistent effect + grab state).
Retrosaber: the overcharge dice are the overcharge profile's damage; the swift dial-up duration is activation state (I-B).
Neuronic whip: stun damage plus a separately rolled slashing rider (5D-C components / 5D-E riders).
All five sonic weapons publish damageType energy (never sonic), so DR/resistance/immunity decisions already see energy damage.
San-Ni staff: stun is chosen per attack (damageMode on the attack), costing no action.
Bluebolt blaster pistol: a stun attack consumes two shots through the canonical per-attack resource cost (5D-D); regression-tested.

Shockboxing gloves: switching to the stun setting costs its published swift action ONCE; the setting persists on the owned item (fire state) until an attack uses the other setting. Only the switch to stun is priced (no cost is stated for switching back).

Dual-phase extended / retrosaber overcharge (swift) and Amphistaff venom spit (standard): the activation lasts across attacks (until the end of the next turn), so it needs persisted activation state, not a per-attack charge.
Long-handle forgo-Strength choice (wielding) and the Siang lance bayonet attack-of-opportunity choice (reach-and-threat).
Amphistaff quarterstaff / spear forms require that configuration (configuration-and-wielding).

Haft-end forms require the feat "Long Haft Form", which is not an ability in the corpus (the unlocking ability is Long Haft Strike -- the 5D-H relation fix). A DATA_COMPLETENESS finding for I-B to correct from the source together with the wielding model.
Battering ram: two operators (stabilize + trigger) -- crew-and-emplacement.
Amphistaff whip forms require a proficient wielder; bound to the configuration state above.

Snare pistol / rifle: the structured target requirement (registered condition: hostile target at up to short range / a character at range) is evaluated from the observed range band, disposition and target type; a definite "no" refuses before any cost, an unobserved fact is asked once.
Battering ram: normal damage only against a stationary unattended object; the fact is asked once and a definite "no" refuses the attack.
Amphistaff venom spit: once per 24 standard hours (a persisted usage counter -- resource owner).
Long-handle two-handed base override: needs the wielding (hands) model.
SG-4: scale-range 0.5 underwater (blaster) / out of water (harpoon). Evaluated through condition-policy; an unobserved environment applies nothing (never a blanket restriction).
